themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Disposal Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints spiked to 12 THIS WEEK versus 2.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks—a 433% increase (z-score: 7.51)—suggesting either a public health event, animal die-off, or enforcement gap in street sanitation that requires immediate investigation.
evidence: 12 dead animal complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.2 weekly average (433% spike, z-score 7.51)
Sharpest spike in 8-week dataset by z-score magnitude
Concentrated in single week suggesting acute event rather than drift
reporting_angles: Interview DSNY/Sanitation about response protocols and whether crews are overwhelmed
Check if animal control or wildlife has noted unusual mortality patterns in the district (disease, poison, environmental trigger)

themes_detail.label: Street Tree Damage Surge
themes_detail.summary: Damaged tree complaints reached 17 THIS WEEK, up 216% from 5.4 weekly average—the highest absolute volume spike in the dataset—suggesting recent severe weather, vandalism, or maintenance negligence affecting the urban canopy.
evidence: 17 damaged tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 5.4 weekly average (216% spike, z-score 3.88)
Highest single-week complaint count for any spiking category
Suggests concentrated event (storm, cutting, disease) rather than chronic understaffing
reporting_angles: Determine if recent weather (wind, ice) caused damage or if there's evidence of unauthorized tree work
Interview Parks Dept on maintenance backlog and response time in Sheepshead Bay/Gravesend

themes_detail.label: Dirty Streets & Lot Blight
themes_detail.summary: Dirty condition complaints jumped 282% to 74 THIS WEEK (vs. 19.4 avg) and lot condition complaints hit 700% spike—both among the highest z-scores (5.02 and 5.42)—indicating a coordinated sanitation or code enforcement problem across the district.
evidence: Dirty condition: 74 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 19.4 weekly average (282% spike, z-score 5.02)
Lot condition: 3 complaints last week vs. 0.4 average (700% spike, z-score 5.42)
Two related categories spiking simultaneously suggests systemic cleanliness breakdown rather than isolated complaints
reporting_angles: Map the complaints geographically—are they concentrated near waterfront (Sheepshead Bay) or specific neighborhoods?
Interview Parks/Sanitation on staffing levels and whether recent budget cuts or route changes affected the district

themes_detail.label: Traffic & Vehicle Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Traffic complaints spiked 269% to 6 last week (vs. 1.6 avg, z-score 5.11) and vehicle noise jumped 167% to 9 complaints (vs. 3.4 avg, z-score 3.99)—a two-week trend suggesting either illegal drag racing, truck rerouting, or transit construction.
evidence: Traffic complaints: 6 last week vs. 1.6 weekly average (269% spike, z-score 5.11)
Vehicle noise: 9 last week vs. 3.4 weekly average (167% spike, z-score 3.99)
Two related categories spiking suggests common cause (construction, illegal racing, major street closure)
reporting_angles: Check with NYPD and 61st Precinct for reports of illegal street racing or noise complaints from residents
Confirm whether DOE street work, waterfront construction, or rezoning-related activity is causing rerouting

themes_detail.label: Dangerous Infrastructure & Signs
themes_detail.summary: Damaged street signs spiked 357% two weeks ago (4 vs. 0.9 avg, z-score 4.0)—a secondary but notable signal—combined with ongoing 530 DOB permit filings (mostly alterations) suggesting either construction damage to street infrastructure or deferred maintenance.
evidence: Damaged street signs: 4 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.9 weekly average (357% spike, z-score 4.0)
530 DOB permits filed in 90-day window, 323 alterations—suggests active construction activity
Three active ULURP rezonings (1417 Ave U, 2555 Shell Rd, 2959 Ave Y) may be driving street work
reporting_angles: Cross-reference damaged sign locations with DOB permit activity to determine if construction crews are responsible
Monitor whether rezoning projects are causing temporary infrastructure damage that city should repair
